message.content:
This is a printed reproduction on canvas, stretched on wooden bars and framed. Chapter 49 covers printed pictures, heading 4911. Subheading 4911.91 covers pictures, designs and photographs, and 4911.91.40 covers lithographs on paper or paperboard, which doesn't fit canvas. The remaining options under 4911.91 are 4911.91.20 (printed in sheets over 20 years old), 4911.91.30 (photographs), 4911.91.40 (lithographs), and 4911.91.80 (other).

Canvas-printed reproductions with frames are often ruled under 4911.91.80 or, when the frame gives the item its essential character, under 9701. However, 9701 covers hand-painted works, and a digital print on canvas is not one. CBP rulings on giclée canvas prints generally place them in 4911.91.2000 or 4911.91.8000, with the statistical suffix depending on the case. The 4911.91.80 line has suffixes 4911.91.8000 (other).

Limited-edition prints signed by the artist could fall under 9702 (original engravings, prints and lithographs). However, 9702 requires the prints to be produced directly from plates made entirely by hand by the artist, so a digital reproduction does not qualify. The best fit is therefore 4911.91.8000.
